## Overview

This was a group project I did with five other students using Power BI. 
The objective was to take data from an Excel spreadsheet containing information 
about a fictional company called Agrifoods. We then had to upload the data to Power BI, 
where we could create visualisations and generate insights about the crucial information 
contained in the spreadsheet.
